description: This file defines the LocalizationEntries class, which manages localization data including retrieval, updating, and synchronization of localization entries within OrchardCore CMS. It interacts with a document store and indexes to maintain localization state.

classes.name: LocalizationEntries
classes.description: Manages localization entries, including caching, retrieval, and synchronization with the database and indexes.

methods.name: TryGetLocalizationAsync
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a localization entry by content item ID asynchronously.

methods.name: GetLocalizationsAsync
methods.description: Retrieves all localization entries for a given localization set asynchronously.

methods.name: UpdateEntriesAsync
methods.description: Updates the localization entries cache by refreshing data from the index.

methods.name: EnsureInitializedAsync
methods.description: Ensures the localization entries are initialized and up-to-date.

methods.name: AddEntries
methods.description: Adds new localization entries to the cache.

methods.name: RemoveEntries
methods.description: Removes specified localization entries from the cache.

methods.name: RefreshEntriesAsync
methods.description: Refreshes the cache based on the latest index and state.

methods.name: InitializeEntriesAsync
methods.description: Initializes the cache with existing localization data.
